title: Knowledge Index Rebuild V1 (the answer to a rebuild request)
$comment: DL-KB-02. POST /api/knowledge-entries/index-rebuild rebuilds the derived FTS5 table from the canonical revision rows and answers with what it actually indexed. `indexed` is the number of rows written during this rebuild, not a count read back from the index afterwards; `index` is the state the read routes will report from now on. A rebuild that indexed zero rows while `index.rows` is non-zero would mean the canonical table is empty, not that the index is fine -- the numbers are separate so that difference stays visible. Nothing here changes an entry: a rebuild that altered canonical bytes would make the index a second truth source.
